description: Committees are groups of 4 specific profession roles that must all be filled. Each committee slot requires a distinct profession type. Committees drive the late-game goal — you need to grow one human of each role per committee.
notes: mem_recipe: minimum memory items (contamination-safe). food_recipe: minimum food items. override_reason: why the recipe differs from the naive optimizer output.

committees.name: Transit & Distribution
committees.description: Owns the arteries of orbit: lift schedules, cargo paths, docking flows, and who gets what where without chaos. It decides routing priorities (medical vs food vs parts), congestion rules, escort requirements, and how tightly distribution is locked down during unrest. In lore terms: this is where 'fairness vs efficiency' becomes a timetable and a locked container.
